sample: fresh random sample of 40 counted instances across the 17 US texts (seed 7), hand-coded by Claude
false_positive_types: funding/budget mechanics (credited, PAYGO), constitutive rules (members shall have equal responsibility, rates shall include), exemptions ('is not required'), 'shall permit', saving clauses, descriptive 'must'
addressee_note: US statutes and especially the CFR use devices, systems, applications and passive voice as subjects ('a device must', 'emissions shall comply'); these fall into 'unclear'. Addressee shares are not reported for the US comparison.
